name: duocode-editor
description: CodeMirror 6 editor bundled into App/Resources/Editor for Mobile Studio's WKWebView

scripts.build: esbuild src/ext/node-host.js --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outfile=../App/Resources/Editor/node-host.js && esbuild src/ext/worker.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=safari16 --outfile=build/ext-worker.txt && esbuild src/main.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=safari16 --loader:.wasm=binary --loader:.txt=text --outfile=../App/Resources/Editor/editor.bundle.js
